description: A world can be asked to serve a conversation over NATS: bridge answers agent.v1.{world}.requests.service, spawning, adopting, or taking over per the conversation's own attachment record, and rejects every other request leaf honestly.
AppendFile flushes its write before returning, so a reader that opens the file immediately after the append sees the appended content instead of an empty file.

An Exec call states a required timeout in whole seconds and is killed when it passes, so a command that never exits returns an ordinary tool error the agent can work around instead of blocking the turn and leaving the conversation unable to be spoken to until someone kills the process by hand. A bridge caps the value with BRIDGE_EXEC_MAX_TIMEOUT, unset meaning no cap; the cap it enforces appears in the tool's own schema, and a call asking for more is rejected rather than quietly reduced.
